scripts.android-staging: export ENVFILE=.env.staging && npx react-native run-android --mode stagingdebug
scripts.android-staging:clean: export ENVFILE=.env.staging && cd android && ./gradlew clean && cd .. && npx react-native run-android --mode stagingdebug
scripts.android-staging-release: export ENVFILE=.env.staging && npx react-native run-android --mode stagingrelease
scripts.android-staging-release:clean: export ENVFILE=.env.staging && cd android && ./gradlew clean && cd .. && npx react-native run-android --mode stagingrelease
scripts.android-production: export ENVFILE=.env.production && npx react-native run-android --mode productiondebug
scripts.android-production:clean: export ENVFILE=.env.production && cd android && ./gradlew clean && cd .. && npx react-native run-android --mode productiondebug
scripts.android-production-release: export ENVFILE=.env.production && npx react-native run-android --mode productionrelease
scripts.ios-staging: export ENVFILE=.env.staging  && npx react-native run-ios --scheme Doitpay-Staging --mode Debug --simulator="iPhone 17 Pro"
scripts.ios-production: export ENVFILE=.env.production  && npx react-native run-ios --scheme Doitpay-Production --mode Release --simulator="iPhone 17 Pro"
scripts.clean-run-android: rm -rf yarn.lock && rm -rf node_modules && yarn install && cd android && ./gradlew clean && cd .. && yarn android-staging
scripts.build:android-staging: export ENVFILE=.env.staging && cd android && ./gradlew assembleStagingRelease && cd ..
scripts.build:android-staging:clean: export ENVFILE=.env.staging && rm -rf android/app/build && cd android && ./gradlew assembleStagingRelease --rerun-tasks && cd ..
scripts.build:android-production: export ENVFILE=.env.production && cd android && ./gradlew assembleProductionRelease && cd ..
scripts.build:android-production:clean: export ENVFILE=.env.production && rm -rf android/app/build && cd android && ./gradlew assembleProductionRelease --rerun-tasks && cd ..
scripts.build-bundle:android-staging:clean: export ENVFILE=.env.staging && rm -rf android/app/build && cd android && ./gradlew bundleStagingRelease --rerun-tasks && cd ..
scripts.build-bundle:android-production:clean: export ENVFILE=.env.production && rm -rf android/app/build && cd android && ./gradlew bundleProductionRelease --rerun-tasks && cd ..
scripts.ios:clean: rm -rf ios/build && cd ios && xcodebuild clean && cd ..
scripts.build:ios-staging: ENVFILE=.env.staging cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace DoitPayMobileApp.xcworkspace -scheme Doitpay-Staging -configuration StagingRelease -sdk iphoneos -derivedDataPath build -allowProvisioningUpdates && cd ..
scripts.build:ios-production: ENVFILE=.env.production cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace DoitPayMobileApp.xcworkspace -scheme Doitpay-Production -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -derivedDataPath build -allowProvisioningUpdates CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS=DoitpayMobileApp/DoitpayMobileApp.production.entitlements && cd ..
scripts.archive:ios-staging: ENVFILE=.env.staging cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace DoitPayMobileApp.xcworkspace -scheme Doitpay-Staging -configuration StagingRelease archive -archivePath build/Doitpay-Staging.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates && cd ..
scripts.archive:ios-production: ENVFILE=.env.production cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace DoitPayMobileApp.xcworkspace -scheme Doitpay-Production -configuration Release archive -archivePath build/Doitpay-Production.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS=DoitpayMobileApp/DoitpayMobileApp.production.entitlements && cd ..
scripts.ipa:ios-staging: yarn archive:ios-staging && cd ios && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath build/Doitpay-Staging.xcarchive -exportPath build/Doitpay-StagingIPA -exportOptionsPlist ExportOptions.plist -allowProvisioningUpdates && cd ..
scripts.ipa:ios-production: yarn archive:ios-production && cd ios && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath build/Doitpay-Production.xcarchive -exportPath build/Doitpay-ProductionIPA -exportOptionsPlist ExportOptions.plist -allowProvisioningUpdates && cd ..
